title: You weren’t an accident.
paragraphs: You weren’t an accident.
You were crafted.

Not rushed.
Not random.
Not replaceable.
“For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.” — Ephesians 2:10
Workmanship.

That word in the original Greek—poiēma—means masterpiece.
Art. Intentional design. Something God took His time on.
Let that hit you.

You are not just saved from something.
You are saved for something.
But here’s what we miss…

We chase purpose like it’s hidden.
We hustle for worth like it’s earned.
We perform like God is still undecided about us.
No.

The cross already settled your value.
Jesus didn’t die to make you almost enough.
He finished it.

And now—
your life becomes the evidence of His grace at work.

Good works don’t save you.
They reveal you’ve been remade.
So walk in it.

Not someday.
Not when you feel ready.
Now.

Because the same God who saved you…
already went ahead of you.

Prepared the path.
Ordered the steps.
Wrote purpose into your ordinary days.
You just have to step into it—with Him.

If this stirred something in you, don’t ignore it.
This is your invitation.

From shame to calling.
From drifting to design.
From broken to built by God.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
